# Provider argv fixtures

These fixtures never import a provider entrypoint, contact a service, access credentials or execute a command handler. They are required tests; no installed-provider opt-in is used.

| Fixture | Provenance | Extraction / adaptation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `claudeParser.mjs` | Claude Code 2.1.322, `~/.local/share/claude/versions/2.1.322:2459909` | Installed Commander `parseOptions` and `_findCommand`, formatted with braces; inert option descriptors and outcome recorder replace application callbacks. `_parseCommand` checks command names after parsing. Raw `includes` and connection scan are isolated branch ports, not a complete Claude runtime. |
| `claudeRegistry.json` | Same binary:2459929–2459938,2464840–2464848,2474339,2474369,2474377 | Generated from the installed source by `node scripts/generate-claude-command-registry.mjs <installed-2.1.322-path>`; `--check` independently verifies the outputs. The source SHA-256, 27 root registrations, and all 30 command names/aliases (including `plugins`) are pinned in `claudeRegistrySource.json`; production imports the generated table. Includes conditional gateway/xaa and hidden edit commands. Nested auth/plugin/mcp commands are excluded. `Zi` adds background commands to help only; `_4s` does not dispatch behind `--`. Root action disables implicit help. |
| `pi.mjs` | Pi 0.80.7, `/opt/homebrew/lib/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/dist/cli/args.js:7–197` | Actual pure `parseArgs` and its thinking-level dependency; imports and help omitted. |
| `piPackage.mjs` | Same package, `dist/package-manager-cli.js:140–320` | Actual pure `parsePackageCommand`, exported for inert dispatch recording. `config` is separately recognized at line 465 and before ordinary parsing in `dist/main.js:390`. |
| `stringOptions.mjs` | OpenCode 1.3.13 binary:899121–899129,963676; Gemini 0.32.1 `config.js:54`, bundled `yargs-parser.js:191`; Kimi 1.16.0 `cli/__init__.py:170`, Click `parser.py:368,449` | Narrow ports of typed/attached string-option branches. No unrelated parser package substitutes for the installed parser. |
| `stringOptions.mjs` Codex | Codex 0.166.0 `codex-rs/cli/src/main.rs:128`, `tui/src/cli.rs:16`; Clap 4.5.58 `clap_builder/src/parser/parser.rs:102–134` | Narrow trailing-values branch port; does not claim full Clap coverage. |
| `selectCodexSkills` | Codex 0.166.0 `codex-rs/skills/src/mentions.rs:88–149,226–228` | Inert skill selection for the fixture catalog. Quotes and backslashes do not escape the sigil scan. The production refusal is intentionally conservative, including common environment-variable candidates. |

The tests pass actual planner argv through these fixtures and check both control options and prompt value. Negative controls independently demonstrate command dispatch, raw flag activation, connection selection, Pi file interpretation, lost delimiter and unsafe string-option encodings. These fixtures establish the covered parser branches; provider upgrades and real Windows shell execution require separate compatibility verification.
